segments.text: Why isn't 21,000 gas enough for a simple ETH transfer anymore?
EIP-8037 splits gas into two dimensions: execution and state. Amsterdam ships the change.
One wei to a brand-new account.
Execution stays around 21,000. State gas: about 183,600.
Now the wallet default — a 21,000 gas limit.
Out of gas. That's the simple transfer that no longer fits.
No state meter on this fork.
Amsterdam first-touch needs both meters. A funded recipient stays cheap. A new storage slot bills state gas too.
Spec on Forkcast. Try the other scenarios on feelyourprotocol dot org.
